meta.name: google-analytics
meta.description: Analyze connected Google Analytics 4 traffic, acquisition, engagement, landing pages, ecommerce, events, and conversions, and safely manage supported GA4 key events or custom dimensions through NotFair MCP. Use for GA4, Google Analytics, traffic or conversion drops, channel attribution, realtime activity, report requests, measurement configuration, or Analytics MCP setup.

copy.tagline: 查看GA4流量与转化数据，辅助营销分析。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常要分析网站流量和转化数据。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze GA4 traffic and conversions to understand channel performance.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to analyze website traffic and conversion data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取你已连接的 Google Analytics 4 数据，分析流量、来源、转化等指标，生成带对比的报告；如果你想改关键事件或自定义维度，它会先说明影响并征求同意。
howto.when: 当你说到“GA4”、“流量下降”、“转化率”等关键词，或要求看实时数据、做报告、配置测量时触发；前提是已经连好 GA4 账户。

say.text: 分析最近30天的网站流量和转化变化。
say.note: Claude 会拉取对应报告并说明变化和可能原因。

say.text: 对比本季度和上季度的用户来源。
say.note: Claude 会按渠道等维度对比并给出差异。
Claude 会先展示当前状态和影响，征求你同意后操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads your connected Google Analytics 4 data, analyzes metrics like traffic, sources, and conversions, and produces comparison reports. For key-event or custom-dimension changes, it explains the impact and asks for your approval first.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you mention keywords like "GA4", "traffic drop", "conversion rate", or ask for realtime activity, report requests, or measurement configuration. Requires a connected GA4 account.

say_en.text: Analyze website traffic and conversion changes for the last 30 days.
say_en.note: Claude pulls the report and explains changes and likely causes.

say_en.text: Compare user sources between this quarter and last quarter.
say_en.note: Claude compares by channel etc. and highlights differences.
Claude shows current state and impact, then asks your approval.
